mechanism: Open with one compact flat icon, expand it into a character-and-world poster system, raise graphic density through several symbolic environment modules, interrupt the density with one short isolated system-status state, then let the last character frame hand off to a held final lockup built from the recurring palette and panel geometry. Do not claim that visually similar objects across modules are the same physical token unless continuity is directly shown.

invariants.rule: Open with one compact flat icon that visibly expands into a larger graphic field.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting at full density removes the expansion hook.

invariants.rule: Keep one character silhouette, palette and panel family stable while the world modules change.
invariants.purpose: Prevents editorial variety from breaking identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing every anchor turns the piece into unrelated posters.

invariants.rule: Raise graphic density through at least two symbolically different environment modules.
invariants.purpose: Builds escalation beyond simple background swapping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one corridor cannot create a PV information ladder.

invariants.rule: Insert one short isolated status or negative-space state before the ending.
invariants.purpose: Creates contrast and a readable pause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous high density makes the final lockup feel unearned.

invariants.rule: Resolve the recurring palette and panel geometry into a held final lockup after the last character frame hands off.
invariants.purpose: Closes the graphic family without inventing a final character composite.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated title card discards the accumulated visual grammar.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: cyan folder icon, white rabbit and monochrome source character
dream archive, memory diver and erased source titles
magenta door corridor, bed, giant eye and source device slot
the exact source game-PV panels, poster order and final logo
